subject: Obstruction - Halifax Harbour and Approaches - Georges Island
text:
Obstruction - Halifax Harbour and Approaches - Georges Island
Four fiberglass sonar targets are deployed in Halifax Harbour near Georges Island.
A 20 cm x 60 cm seafloor cone will be deployed in 44 38.627N 063 33.427W.
A 60 cm spherical water column will be deployed 5 metres off the seabed in 44 38.577N 063 33.367W.
A 50 cm x 50 cm seafloor hollow cylinder will be deployed in 44 38.525N 063 33.333W.
A 50 cm x 100 cm seafloor cylinder will be deployed in 44 38.408N 063 33.137W.
The units will be fully submerged with no buoy lines attached and will be retrieved using divers following sonar demonstration. Caution.
                                                    Cancels NW-M-0133-26
